tree.heading: Availability of appropriated funds
tree.text: Amounts appropriated under this chapter shall remain available until expended.

tree.heading: Administrative expenses
tree.text: Of the amounts appropriated to carry out this chapter for a fiscal year, the Secretaries may expend not more than five percent to cover the administrative expenses necessary to carry out this chapter.
